message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.**  
Noise violations are handled by the city’s code‑enforcement and police departments, and the city provides several convenient ways to report them.

| How to File | What to Do | Contact |
|-------------|------------|---------|
| **Online Form** | Go to the City’s 311 portal and fill out the “Noise Complaint” form. | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311/noise> |
| **Phone** | Call the 311 non‑emergency line (or the police department if you’re in immediate danger). | 311 (or 404‑656‑4000 for the Police Department) |
| **Email** | Send a brief description of the issue to the city’s noise‑complaint email address. | noise@atlantaga.gov |
| **In‑person** | Visit the City Hall or a local police station to file a written complaint. | City Hall, 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

### Quick Steps

1. **Identify the problem** – note the time, location, and type of noise (e.g., construction, loud music, barking dogs).  
2. **Choose a method** – online, phone, email, or in‑person.  
3. **Provide details** – include your contact information, the exact address, and any evidence (photos, audio recordings, or witness statements).  
4. **Submit** – the city will assign a case number and follow up.  

### Where the Law Comes From

- **Atlanta Municipal Code – Title 10, Chapter 10 (Noise)**  
  This section sets the permissible decibel limits and quiet hours.  
  <https://www.atlantaga.gov/municipal-code>

### If You Want to Escalate

- **Contact Your City Council Member** – each council member has an office that can help you track the complaint or bring it to council attention.  
  Find your representative here: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/city-council>

### Quick Reference

| Resource | Link |
|----------|------|
| 311 Portal (general) | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| Noise Complaint Form | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311/noise> |
| City Code (Noise) | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/municipal-code> |
| City Council | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/city-council> |

**Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the 311 system, phone, email, or in‑person visit to file your complaint, and the city will investigate and take appropriate action.
